description: This file defines the 'Services' class within the Thunder::Broadcast namespace, which manages DVB service information, including scanning, loading, and maintaining a list of services, as well as handling tuner notifications and SDT parsing.

classes.name: Services
classes.description: Manages DVB services, handles scanning, loading service data, and responds to tuner notifications.

classes.name: Services::Sink
classes.description: Implements ITuner::INotification to handle tuner activation, deactivation, and state changes.

classes.name: Services::Parser
classes.description: Parses SDT sections from tuner data streams to update service information.

classes.name: Services::Service
classes.description: Represents individual DVB service with properties like ServiceId, Name, and flags.

methods.name: Services::Scan
methods.description: Starts or stops scanning for services.

methods.name: Services::Id
methods.description: Retrieves a service by its ServiceId.

methods.name: Services::List
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the list of services.

methods.name: Services::Load
methods.description: Loads service data from an SDT table.
